rationale: The digest shows emailservice latency-90 spiking by 16,752% (z=+358.88) alongside a 97% memory increase, while checkoutservice logs repeatedly report 'no healthy upstream' RPC errors when calling it. This confirms emailservice is severely degraded, causing checkoutservice failures and cascading latency to the frontend.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or scale up emailservice instances to restore healthy upstream connections and reduce latency.
